apiErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
apiErrors.ACTOR_NOT_SELF: You can't act on another player's behalf.
apiErrors.CHAT_NOT_MEMBER: You're not part of this chat.
apiErrors.CHAT_CALL_NO_PARTICIPANTS: There's nobody else in the chat to call.
apiErrors.CHAT_GROUP_NO_ACCESS: You don't have access to this group.
apiErrors.CHAT_MEMBERSHIP_FIXED: This chat’s member list cannot be changed.
apiErrors.BANK_ACCOUNT_NOT_OWNED: You can't transfer from an account that isn't yours.
apiErrors.BANK_AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount must be greater than zero.
apiErrors.BANK_SAME_ACCOUNT: You can't transfer to the same account.
apiErrors.TAXI_STOP_NOT_FOUND: That taxi stop no longer exists.
apiErrors.TAXI_PLAYER_OFFLINE: You need to be connected to the server to travel.
apiErrors.TAXI_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: You do not have enough balance for this trip.
apiErrors.TAXI_UNSAFE_ARRIVAL: There is nowhere safe to drop you off at that stop.
apiErrors.TAXI_IN_DUNGEON_RUN: You cannot take a taxi during a dungeon run.
apiErrors.TAXI_SERVER_BUSY: The server did not answer in time. You have not been charged.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_TEAMSHEET_LOCKED: Teamsheets are locked — the tournament has already started.
apiErrors.EVENT_LIFECYCLE_FORWARD_ONLY: The event lifecycle only moves forward. Tick "reopen" if you really mean to move it back.
apiErrors.EVENT_REOPEN_BLOCKED_BY_RANDOMIZER: Cannot reopen: this event has a randomizer that is no longer a draft. Close or delete it first.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_PARTICIPANT_IN_BRACKET: That entrant is already in the bracket. Set their status to withdrew or disqualified instead of deleting them.
apiErrors.MATCH_SETTLED_CONCURRENTLY: The match was settled while you were submitting. Reload it before correcting the result.
apiErrors.MATCH_AMENDMENT_CONFLICT: The match was corrected by another admin. Reload it before correcting again.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_TEAMSHEET_REQUIRED: Submit your teamsheet before checking in.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_EVENT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED: This tournament belongs to an event — join the event before registering.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_PROPOSAL_ALREADY_EXISTS: There's already a proposed result for this match.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_PROPOSAL_AUTO_VERIFIED: The proposal was auto-verified — ask a judge to correct it.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_PROPOSAL_INVALIDATED: The proposal is no longer valid due to a match amendment.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_PROPOSAL_SETTLED_CONCURRENTLY: The proposal was settled while you were disputing it.
apiErrors.EVENT_DELETE_BLOCKED_BY_TOURNAMENT: Cannot delete this event — it has an attached tournament. Delete or detach the tournament first.
apiErrors.TOURNAMENT_REOPEN_BLOCKED_BY_COMPLETED_E: That tournament belongs to an event that is already completed, so it cannot be reopened.
